# Cully v0.10.1

Patch release: stop the Cursor terminal panel from looking broken when model and context never arrive.

- In Cursor (and other agents without a usage feed), Model and Context now show **unavailable** instead of **waiting for agent**. Cursor has no Codex footer or Claude statusline feed for those rows. Tokens and rate limits already said unavailable. Claude and Codex still wait for their real feeds.
- Docs and the Cully skill describe this Cursor limit so the panel is not mistaken for a setup failure.

Upgrade: install the v0.10.1 CLI (`install.sh` or your usual path) and restart `cully run cursor` / the advisor daemon if it was already running. No schema migration.
